memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord spoke to Moses in the tent of meeting in the Desert of Sinai on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. - Num 1:1 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Notice where God chooses to speak — in a desert, in a tent, in the middle of nowhere. The Israelites were not yet in the Promised Land. They were still travelling, still waiting, still living in temporary shelters. And it is right there, in the wilderness season, that God meets Moses and gives clear instructions.

We often think God will speak to us once we "arrive" — once life settles down, once the difficult season passes, once we reach the place we are hoping for. But here God shows us something beautiful. He does not wait for comfortable surroundings. He speaks in the desert. He speaks to people who are still on the way.

The care with which the date is recorded — the exact day, month, and year — reminds us that God works in real history, at real times, with real people. Your life is not a blur to Him. He knows the exact season you are in right now.

If you feel like you are in a wilderness today, take heart. God has a habit of speaking clearly to His people precisely there. The same God who met Moses in the tent of meeting meets us today through His Word and, ultimately, through His Son, who is God's final and clearest word to us (Heb 1:1-2).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Where is your "wilderness" right now?
- Are you waiting to "arrive" before you listen to God?
- How can you make space to hear Him today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You speak even in my desert seasons. Help me to listen for Your voice today, right where I am. Amen.
